result.summary: The screen mostly renders cleanly. The carousel and bottom-cut content are excluded as intended. A few visual defects remain, chiefly in the bottom navigation bar and the first carousel card. The bottom nav is overlapped by the system gesture bar, and the first card's image is inconsistent with the others.

issues.description: The system gesture/home indicator bar overlaps the bottom navigation icons. It strikes through the Search icon and crowds the Orders icon, so the tab bar looks broken. The tab icons also have no labels, and the bottom nav appears clipped at the screen edge.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom safe-area inset padding so the nav bar sits above the gesture indicator. Keep the icons fully visible, and consider adding labels.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the Green Bowl Poké card has a light gray/white background while the other cards are dark. The time badge ('15–25 min') overlaps the plate illustration, and the plate is cut off at the right side of the image. This makes the first card look inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent image framing and backgrounds. Center the dish and position the badge so it does not cover the subject.

issues.description: The white heart icon on the pizza card's semi-transparent dark circle has weak contrast against the light pizza image. The green '€0 delivery' badge text on white is also small. The gray secondary text (e.g. '€0.90 delivery', '25–35 min') is low contrast.
issues.suggestion: Use a more opaque background behind the favorite icon. Darken the secondary text to meet WCAG AA contrast, and increase the badge text size.

issues.description: The promo banner has decorative translucent circles that create an uneven, hard-edged shape in the bottom right, with a visible corner artifact near the banner's edge.
issues.suggestion: Clip the decorative shapes cleanly within the rounded banner and smooth the overlapping edges.
